answer.answerText:
No. A filing representative may perform data entry, but cannot submit a job filing or attest in place of the applicant or owner. The applicant must complete the Applicant of Record’s attestation and provide the final electronic signature; the owner must complete the Owner’s Attestation confirming authorization for the applicant to submit and acknowledging review of the application. Accordingly, the applicant and owner must complete their own attestations before the applicant officially submits the job filing to the Department. The occupancy group of the main use or dominant occupancy of the building; 3. The construction type of the building in accordance with Section 602 of the New York City Building Code ; 4. The structure category in accordance with Table 1604.5 of the New York City Building Code ; 5. The height of the building as defined in Section 202 of the New York City Building Code ; 6. The applicable measurements to the highest and lowest level of Fire Department access; 7. Whether the building is inside or outside of the fire districts; and 8. Whether the building is inside or outside a flood hazard area as such term is defined in Chapter 2 of the New York City Building Code . (Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023) Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077 .

107.5 107.5 Plumbing plans. Construction documents for plumbing work shall contain plans which include the following data and information. Such plans shall not be required in connection with applications for limited plumbing alterations. 1. Riser diagrams showing the story heights, all plumbing fixtures with diagrammatic arrangement of their connections to soil, waste, and vent piping, all soil, waste, and vent stacks from the point of connection with the building drain to their termination above the roof, all leader and storm water piping from the point of connection with the building drain to the roof drain, and all risers. 2. Diagrammatic floor plans showing the location, layout, and spacing of all plumbing fixtures, the summation of plumbing loads, the size, location, and material for all building sewers and drains, and the soil, waste, vent, water, and gas distribution piping. 3. Floor plans showing typical layouts; and stack details shown on one drawing, provided that such details are clearly identified as to location and stack number. 4. Plans clearly indicating all appurtenant equipment, including, but not limited to, pumps, ejectors, water tanks, and piping. 5. The relative elevation of the lowest fixture referred to the city datum provided in Section 28-104.7.6 of the Administrative Code and the approximate inside top of the public sewers; 5.2. The number, size, and location of all proposed sewer connections and relative location and size of all water mains, leaders, and risers; and 5.3. A statement from the Department of Environmental Protection, giving the minimum water pressure in the main serving the building. 6. Seismic protection and restraint details for piping and equipment as required by Chapter 16 of the New York City Building Code. 7. Details showing structural supports for water tanks where required. 8. In flood hazard areas, construction documents shall comply with Appendix G of the New York City Building Code . (Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023) Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077 .

107.6 107.6 Discharge of sewage and discharge and/or management of stormwater runoff. Applications for construction document approval shall comply with Sections 107.6.1, 107.6.2 and 107.6.3. (Am. L.L. 2017/097, 5/30/2017, eff. 6/1/2019)
107.7 107.7 Private sewers. If private sewers are to be constructed pursuant to subdivision b of Section 1403 of the New York City Charter , a copy of the sewer plan shall be submitted.

"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"penalty fee has to be paid before the permit is issued. "},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"Once legalization is selected on a filing, it results in a no work pe rmit and Post Approval
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"Amendments are not allowed. "},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"See 1 RCNY 102 - 04 (b) (7 ) for more information about legalization and civil penalties.
"},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"The work is being done to legalize work without a permit listed as a violating condition in a Request for Corrective Action ( RCA) issued by DOB?
"},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"– if Yes is selected, provide the complaint number of the RCA. "},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"See 1 RCNY 102 - 06 and the September 2021 Service Notice for information about the
"},{"spanIndex":35,"text":"Homeowner Relief Program.

"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"STATEMENTS & SIGNATURES
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"Applicant o f Record ’s Attestation
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"The applicant completes the section to provide an electronic signature before the application can be submitted. "},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"The applicant also uploads a
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"Design Professional/Licensee Seal and Signature Form (DPL - 1) as a Required Document. "},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"The date on the form cannot be more than one year from
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"the date of submission.
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"Owner’s Attestation
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"All job filings in DOB NOW require confirmation from the Owner authorizing the applicant to submit the filing and acknowledging that the
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"information in the application has been reviewed. "},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"An Owner provides confirmation by completing the Owner’s Attestation sectio n of the
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"Statements & Signatures tab .
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"Occupied Dwelling Units (Questions 1 - 4)
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"If the owner selects Yes to Question 1, occupied dwelling units during construction , a Tenant Protection Plan (TPP) is required. "},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"A TPP is required if
"},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"residential units will be occupied any time before the permit is signed off by DOB. "},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"Questions 3 - 4 determine compliance requirement s with tenant
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"protection laws based on whether residential units are occupied at the time of application.
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Rent Controlled or Rent Stabilized Housing (Questions 5 - 6)
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"This information is checked with data provided by NYS Homes and Community Renewal (DHCR) if at least one rent - regulated unit is in the building.
"},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"If there is at least one rent - regulated unit in the building and the owner checks No to Question 5, a document is required confirming the building
"},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"contains 0 rent controlled/stabilized units and expla ining why the DHCR records are inaccurate. "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"Otherwise, owners must check Yes to Question 5.
"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"Loft Board Notification (Question 7)
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"Owners proposing work to convert their loft buildings into legal residences are required to notify the NYC Loft Board at (212 ) 393 - 2603 and ask for
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"the Public Information Officer.
"},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"Interior Work (Questions 8 - 10)
"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"If the proposed work requires a TPP and the owner checks Yes to Questions 8, 9, or 10, a Tenant Protection Plan Compliance special inspection will
"},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"not be required.
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"Owner Arrears (Questions 11 - 12)
"},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"This section appears on New Building, Alteration - CO, and Full Demolition filings to comply with Local Law 160 of 2017 . "},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"If the owner answers Yes to
"},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"either question, a list of exceptions will appear as Question 13. "},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"If an exception is not selected, a permit cannot be obtaine d."}]},{"passageIndex":2,"sourceID":"dob-stakeholder-faq","claimID":"official-passage-5721b18038eef3a58c0d5e97","contentHash":"5a17747294c81fe3bc9bffb893394e76bbbd0cd3d5d612fd8b1fbf00b39d2d01","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Roles & Responsibilities: Owner — As an owner, what information can I enter and access in DOB NOW: Build ? — Owners can review the filing, complete the Owner’s Attestation section on the Statements and Signatures tab and make payments on their jobs. "},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"They can make payments on jobs that they are associated with. "},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"Architect, or a Horticulturist with a degree or
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"certificate from an accredited training institute.
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"• Owner’s Attestation: Owners will need to log in to

"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"applicant to file the application.
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"▪ Both the owner and the Board representative are required complete their attestations on the Statements & Signatures tab before
